description: Stylesheet for the weather insights frontend application, defining theme colors and various layout styles for components including header, search input, weather display, and footer.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container class that centers content and sets the overall background color.

classes.name: header
classes.description: Styles for the application header, including background color, padding, and box shadow.

classes.name: search-container
classes.description: Container for search input and button, with flexbox layout and gap between elements.

classes.name: search-input
classes.description: Styling for the search input field, defining border and padding.

classes.name: search-button
classes.description: Styles for the search button, including background color, padding, and hover effect.

classes.name: main-content
classes.description: Main content area styling with max-width and padding.

classes.name: weather-display
classes.description: Container for displaying weather information with a white background and shadow.

classes.name: forecast-container
classes.description: Grid layout for forecast cards, defining responsive behavior.

classes.name: forecast-card
classes.description: Styling for individual forecast cards, including background and padding.

classes.name: footer
classes.description: Footer styling similar to the header, with padding and text alignment.

classes.name: loading
classes.description: Styles for loading state, centering loading indicator.

classes.name: error-message
classes.description: Styles for error messages, with distinct color and padding.
